subject: Compliance priorities and document delivery plan (SOC 2, retention, pen test)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marsh <elena.marsh@nrf-fin.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nrf-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance priorities and artifact delivery — quick post-call notes

Hi Elena / Samir — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of pain points you flagged
- Audit timeline: external audit kickoff targeted for 2027-02; you need artifacts and evidence in late November / December for your SOC 2 preparatory review.
- Retention & archive: primary ask is 7 years for transaction-level audit logs and a 90-day hot/secondary cold access tier.
- Audit logs & access history: you need both immutable audit logs (write-once) and a human-readable events export for scope reviewers.
- Pen test window: you prefer a pen test before the prep audit but after codefreeze (your current window: mid-Oct → early-Nov).

Goals we discussed
- Provide a clear artifact list for your SOC 2 reviewer by 2026-11-15.
- Confirm retention and export format by 2026-10-01.
- Lock a pen-test window (tentative Oct 18–29) and a point contact for scheduling.

What Redwood will provide (initial ask list)
- DDQ matrix (we’ll map answers to your SOC 2 sections). Attachment: nrf-soc2-ddq-v1.xlsx
- Export of audit logs schema and sample events (JSON + CSV).
- Retention design doc + ops runbook excerpt (for your security reviewers).
- Pen test scoping doc and suggested provider list (if you want a vendor).

Immediate asks for your team
1) Confirm the audit artifact cutoff date (targeting 2026-11-15).
2) Confirm whether 7-year retention requirement is a hard contractual requirement or a preference.
3) Identify the contact who will receive artifacts (S3, secure SharePoint, or secure portal).

Next steps (proposed owner & dates)
- Redwood to share the DDQ workbook and playbook by 2026-09-20 — owner: me (karthik).
- Ben to draft the pen-test scope and schedule availability by 2026-09-22 — owner: ben.carter@redwood.ai.
- Elena / Samir to confirm retention obligation and artifact recipient by 2026-09-24 — owner: Northridge security.

Attachments: nrf-soc2-ddq-v1.xlsx (DDQ we started today)

If any of that is off, please flag. Otherwise I’ll queue the docs and Ben will reach out on the pen test logistics.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0191
redwood.ai
From: Elena Marsh <elena.marsh@nrf-fin.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance priorities and artifact delivery — quick post-call notes

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful, appreciate the clear follow-up. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 7-year retention is currently a contractual requirement for a subset of ledger entries (settlement records). We can provide the specific contract clause to you by end of week.
- For audit logs we need: immutable write-ahead export + daily digest (human readable) for reviewers. CSV is fine for the digest; JSON schema for the export preferred.
- Pen test timing: Oct 18–25 is our preferred window; we have a compliance blackout Oct 26–30 for year-end reconciliations.

We’ll accept artifacts to a secure S3 bucket (we'll create a pre-signed path) — Samir will coordinate.

I’m attaching a draft DPA excerpt and our internal evidence checklist (high-level) — see attached: nrf-dpa-excerpt.docx (sent via secure link in separate email).

Elena
Director, InfoSec — Northridge Financial

On Thu, Sep 17, 2026 at 2:12 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Elena / Samir — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 
> ...
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Marsh <elena.marsh@nrf-fin.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nrf-fin.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance priorities and artifact delivery — pen test scope & internal artifact plan

Karthik / Marissa — looping in a concise plan from Redwood sec/ops perspective. I’ll own pen-test scoping and the artifact bundle. Notes below: 

Pen test- Scope: standard OWASP + infrastructure discovery + privilege escalation on inference endpoint. We will not run destructive tests against production; we’ll use a snapshot environment or a scheduled maintenance window.
- Proposed window: Oct 18–22 (matches Northridge preference Oct 18–25).
- Deliverable: findings report + remediation priorities within 7 business days.

Artifact bundle (what we can deliver quickly)
- Audit logs export (immutable): we've got a write-once S3 lifecycle + Glacier policy; will produce a signed manifest and sample exports (JSON).
- Human digest: daily CSV export for last 90 days.
- Retention design doc: maps retention classes to policies and containment.
- Access reviews: scrubbed lists for admin accounts for the last 12 months.

I uploaded a short playbook excerpt here: https://redwoodai.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-321 — it has the artifact templates.

Action items I’ll take now:
1) Draft pen test scope and vendor list — 2026-09-22 EOD.
2) Produce sample audit export (small sample) — 2026-09-24.
3) Create retention mapping doc for your review — 2026-09-29.

Elena / Samir: is there a specific signature/hash format (SHA256 manifest or similar) that you require for immutable artifacts? If so, please confirm and we’ll include it in the export.

— Ben
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marsh <elena.marsh@nrf-fin.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nrf-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance priorities and artifact delivery — confirmation & next meeting

Thanks all — quick confirmation and final logistics so we can move to execution: 

Agreed items
- Audit artifact cutoff: 2026-11-15 (I have this noted as the intake deadline for your SOC 2 reviewer).
- Retention: 7 years for settlement ledger entries (contractual). 
- Pen test window: Oct 18–22 (Redwood to provide scope and vendor options by 09/22).
- Delivery method: secure S3 (Samir to share an ARN + presigned paths).

Delivery commitments (dates and owners)
- 2026-09-20: Redwood shares updated DDQ workbook and playbook excerpt — owner: karthik.
- 2026-09-22: Pen-test scope and vendor list — owner: ben.carter@redwood.ai (Ben).
- 2026-09-24: Sample audit export (JSON + digest CSV) — owner: ben.carter@redwood.ai (Ben).
- 2026-09-29: Retention mapping doc for review — owner: karthik.
- 2026-11-15: Artifact intake cutoff for SOC 2 preparatory review — owner: Northridge security.

Next meeting: I scheduled a 30-minute sync on 2026-09-27 10:00AM PDT to review the sample export and the retention mapping doc. Calendar invite sent; please accept or propose an alternate.

If anything changes on your side re: blackout windows or delivery channels, please reply to this thread so the schedule can shift. Otherwise we’ll proceed on these commitments.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-evidence-playbook.pdf
